policy_definition.invariant: Valid positive non-land prices/areas; retains cancellation and direct-sale labels
policy_definition.strict: Additionally excludes observed cancellation and direct-sale labels; direct-sale labels start2021-11

interval_rule: Conservative displayed bounds, not confidence intervals; derived quantities use displayed endpoints only
primary_cells: District x registered area band x fixed construction cohort anchored to2021
limitations: Transaction reports, not a housing-stock or completed-sale census
Within-group mean changes do not identify the same dwelling or causal price effects
Year-specific age composition differs from the fixed construction cohorts used in decomposition
Protected and unsupported labels remain visible without hidden counts, rates or monetary terms
No exact complex counts or joint-cell means; no arbitrary nonlinear/external-information privacy guarantee
